document_api_meta.title: Update Promotion Activity
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Update an existing promotion activity. The stored activity type determines which request fields are processed:
- For fixed-price, direct-discount, and flash-sale activities, update title, begin_time, and end_time; the other type-specific fields are not processed by this update path.
- For a shipping-discount activity, provide discount.shipping_discount; use duration_type to choose a scheduled or indefinite activity.
- For a Buy More Save More (BMSM) or Buy X Get Y (BXGY) activity, set duration_type to NORMAL, set product_level to PRODUCT or SHOP, provide exactly one participation_limit entry, and provide the matching discount object.
- For a Gift With Purchase (GWP) activity, set duration_type to NORMAL, set product_level to PRODUCT, provide exactly one participation_limit entry, and provide discount.gift_discount.
Fixed-price, direct-discount, flash-sale, BMSM, BXGY, and GWP activities cannot be updated after they are deactivated or expired. For those activity types, an upcoming activity with a normal schedule requires a future begin_time, while an ongoing activity must keep its existing begin_time. An ongoing BMSM or BXGY activity must also keep its existing first-tier threshold value, threshold type, discount type, product scope, participation limit, and target-user setting.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: title
request_body_param.desc: Activity name. The name must be unique. Maximum length: 50 Unicode characters for a flash-sale activity; 50 characters for a shipping-discount activity; 100 Unicode characters for a fixed-price, direct-discount, BMSM, BXGY, or GWP activity.

request_body_param.name: duration_type
request_body_param.desc:
The activity schedule mode.
- For BMSM, BXGY, and GWP activities, set this field to `NORMAL` and provide the scheduled `begin_time` and `end_time`.
- For a shipping-discount activity, use `NORMAL` for a scheduled activity or `INDEFINITE` for an activity without a scheduled end. When this field is omitted for a shipping-discount update, it defaults to `NORMAL`. For `INDEFINITE`, set both `begin_time` and `end_time` to `0`.
- This field is not processed when updating a fixed-price, direct-discount, or flash-sale activity.

request_body_param.name: begin_time
request_body_param.desc: Activity start time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. For an INDEFINITE shipping-discount activity, set this field to 0. For a fixed-price, direct-discount, flash-sale, BMSM, BXGY, or GWP activity with a normal schedule, use a future time when the activity is upcoming; if it is ongoing, use its existing start time because that value cannot be changed.

request_body_param.name: end_time
request_body_param.desc: Activity end time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. For an INDEFINITE shipping-discount activity, set this field to 0. For a normal-schedule fixed-price, direct-discount, flash-sale, BMSM, BXGY, or GWP update, end_time must be at least 600 seconds after begin_time.

request_body_param.name: product_level
request_body_param.desc:
The promotion's product scope. You must provide this field when updating a BMSM, BXGY, GWP, or shipping-discount activity.
- PRODUCT: Applies to a product and all of its SKUs. Use this value for GWP; BMSM, BXGY, and shipping-discount also support it.
- VARIATION: Applies only to specified SKUs. It is not supported for BMSM, BXGY, GWP, or shipping-discount updates.
- SHOP: Applies to all products in the shop. It is supported for BMSM, BXGY, and shipping-discount, but not GWP.
This field is not processed for fixed-price, direct-discount, or flash-sale updates. For an ongoing BMSM or BXGY activity, keep its existing PRODUCT or SHOP scope.

request_body_param.name: participation_limit
request_body_param.desc: The buyer participation limit. For BMSM, BXGY, and GWP updates, provide exactly one entry. If a BMSM or BXGY activity is ongoing, keep its existing participation limit unchanged.

request_body_param.name: ^type
request_body_param.desc:
Determines whether the promotion limits how many orders each buyer can receive the benefit from.
- `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`: Buyers can receive the benefit across multiple orders.
- `BUYER_LIMIT_ONLY_ONE`: Each buyer can receive the benefit for no more than one order.

request_body_param.name: discount
request_body_param.desc: Discount information.

request_body_param.name: ^shipping_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations for the shipping discount, including purchase criteria, discount value, shipping method, inventory type, and area scope.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `NO_THRESHOLD`: No minimum purchase criteria. 
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.
`MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY` and `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT` can only be set when `product_level==SHOP`.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold for the shipping discount, interpreted according to `threshold_type`.
- When `threshold_type` is `NO_THRESHOLD`, this field is not required.
- When `threshold_type` is `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, enter the minimum number of eligible products the buyer must purchase. The value must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type` is `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, enter the minimum eligible-product subtotal in the shop's local currency, for example, 3 units of local currency. The value should have no more than two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The shipping benefit type.
- `FREE_SHIPPING`: Reduces the buyer's shipping charge to zero.
- `DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`: Reduces the buyer's shipping charge by up to the amount specified in `shipping_discount.value`.

request_body_param.name: ^^value
request_body_param.desc:
The shipping discount amount.
- When `type` is `FREE_SHIPPING`, omit this field.
- When `type` is `DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`, enter the maximum amount to deduct from the buyer's shipping charge in the shop's local currency. The value must have no more than two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^shipping_method
request_body_param.desc:
The shipping methods to which this promotion applies.
- When `STANDARD_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Standard Shipping methods, including Economy.
- `EXPRESS_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Express Shipping methods.
- `ALL_SHIPPING_METHOD`: Applies to all shipping methods that the shop offers.
Default: `STANDARD_SHIPPING`

request_body_param.name: ^^inventory_type
request_body_param.desc:
The inventory types to which the promotion activity applies:
- `SELF_FULFILLED`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled from seller warehouses
- `FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled by TikTok from FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) warehouses.
- `ALL`:  Applies to all inventory of eligible products.
Default: `SELF_FULFILLED`
`FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK` and `ALL` can only be set when `product_level`==`SHOP` and `threshold_type=NO_THRESHOLD`.

request_body_param.name: ^^area_scope
request_body_param.desc: The (buyer's) geographical areas to which the promotion activity applies

request_body_param.name: ^^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The buyer's geographical area to which the promotion activity applies.
- `WHOLE`: The promotion activity applies to all areas to which the seller offers fulfillment.
- `SPECIFIC_AREAS`: The promotion activity applies only to fulfillment areas listed in `area_scope.specific_areas`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^specific_areas
request_body_param.desc: The list of areas for which the promotion activity applies. The valid values that may be included in this list are dependent on the region of the shop. The list of valid values for each shop region are available here: [link](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/67e3b059e7dc4f04a4ff9e09)

request_body_param.name: ^bmsm_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations related to Buy More Save More (BMSM) promotions

request_body_param.name: ^^details
request_body_param.desc: Configurations for BMSM promotions. A maximum of two tiers is permitted. `threshold_type` and `type` must be the same across all tiers. When updating an activity, each value must also match the activity's existing threshold type and discount type.

request_body_param.name: ^^^tier
request_body_param.desc: The 1-based tier number. Use `1` for the first tier and `2` for the second tier. For each tier after the first, both `threshold_value` and `value` must be greater than the corresponding values in the previous tier.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold for the discount, based on `threshold_type`.
- When `threshold_type` is `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, enter the minimum number of eligible products the buyer must purchase. The value must be a positive integer.
- When `threshold_type` is `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, enter the minimum eligible-product subtotal in the shop's local currency. The value must be positive and have no more than two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of discount awarded as a benefit. The value of the discount is determined by `value`.
Possible enumerations are:
- `PERCENTAGE_OFF`: Buyer will receive X% off the price of the eligible products.
- `AMOUNT_OFF`: Buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of eligible products.

request_body_param.name: ^^^value
request_body_param.desc:
The positive discount value, interpreted according to `type`.
- When `type` is `PERCENTAGE_OFF`, enter the percentage off eligible products as a positive integer.
- When `type` is `AMOUNT_OFF`, enter the positive amount to deduct from eligible products in the shop's local currency, with no more than two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^gift_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations related to Gift With Purchase (GWP) promotions. Only needs to be configured for GWP promotions.

request_body_param.name: ^^gift_receiving_type
request_body_param.desc:
The receiving type of gift. Currently only one type is supported:
- `ALL_RECEIVE`: All gifts configured in the promotion can be collected.

request_body_param.name: ^^gift_infos
request_body_param.desc: Gift With Purchase (GWP) tier configurations. Provide at least one tier. A maximum of two tiers is permitted in SEA and the UK; only one tier is permitted in the US. `threshold_type` must be the same across all tiers.

request_body_param.name: ^^^tier
request_body_param.desc:
`tier` uses 1-based indexing, i.e. the first and second tiers are counted "1, 2", not "0, 1".
`threshold_value` for a given tier must be greater than that of the previous tier. 
E.g. If `tier`==1 has `threshold_value`==`2`, `tier`==2 must have `threshold_value` > `2`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold type of discount. The threshold type of each tier must be consistent. Possible enumerations are:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The positive purchase threshold for receiving the gift, interpreted according to `threshold_type`.
- When `threshold_type` is `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, enter the minimum number of eligible products the buyer must purchase. The value must be a positive integer.
- When `threshold_type` is `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, enter the minimum eligible-product subtotal in the shop's local currency, for example, 3 units of local currency. The value must be positive and have no more than two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^^gift_details
request_body_param.desc: The gift SKUs for this tier. Across all tiers, provide at least one gift SKU in total, and do not repeat a sku_id anywhere in the activity. For a MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY tier, this list must not be empty.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^product_id
request_body_param.desc: TikTok Shop product id of gift.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^sku_id
request_body_param.desc: TikTok Shop sku id of gift.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^total_claim_limit
request_body_param.desc: The quantity limit of the gift sku which is involved in the activity. The range is [1, 99999].  If you are updating the value of an existing sku, the value cannot be decreased.

request_body_param.name: ^bxgy_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations for Buy X Get Y (BXGY) promotions. Configure this object only for BXGY promotions. When updating an activity, `threshold_type` and `discount_type` must match the activity's existing values.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold type. Possible values:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: The buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: The eligible-product subtotal in the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified amount in the shop's local currency.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold for the discount, interpreted according to `threshold_type`.
- When `threshold_type` is `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, enter the minimum number of eligible products the buyer must purchase. The value must be an integer from 1 to 10.
- When `threshold_type` is `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, enter the minimum eligible-product subtotal in the shop's local currency. The value must be positive and have no more than two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^discount_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of discount awarded as a benefit. The discount amount or percentage is determined by `discount_value`.
Possible values:
- `PERCENTAGE_OFF`: The buyer receives the percentage specified by `discount_value` off eligible products.
- `FREE`: The buyer receives the eligible products for free.
- `AMOUNT_OFF_EACH`: The buyer receives the amount specified by `discount_value`, in the shop's local currency, off each eligible product.

request_body_param.name: ^^discount_value
request_body_param.desc:
Value of the discount.
- When `type`==`PERCENTAGE_OFF`, the buyer will receive X% off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a percentage, it should be an integer.
- `type`==`AMOUNT_OFF_EACH`, the buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of each eligible products. If the value represents a monetary amount, it should be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^benefit_max_applicable_quantity
request_body_param.desc: The maximum quantity of item Y that can receive the BXGY benefit per application. Enter a positive integer from 1 to 20.

request_body_param.name: ^^benefit_max_applicable_times
request_body_param.desc: Optional. The maximum number of times the BXGY benefit can be applied within a single order. Enter a positive integer from 1 to 50.

request_body_param.name: target_user_info
request_body_param.desc: The promotion's target-user configuration. For an ongoing BMSM or BXGY activity, keep the existing target-user setting unchanged and include that existing value in the request.

request_body_param.name: ^user_type
request_body_param.desc:
Possible enumerations are:
`ALL_USER`
`SHOP_NEW_CUSTOMER`
`SHOP_EXISTING_CUSTOMER`
`SHOP_REPEAT_CUSTOMER`

request_body_param.name: auction_support_type
request_body_param.desc:
Determines whether a shipping-discount activity supports auction products. This field is not processed for other activity types.
Possible values:
- `ALL`: Supports both standard and auction products.
- `EXCLUDE_AUCTION`: Excludes auction products.
When omitted for a shipping-discount update, defaults to `ALL`.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^activity_id
response_param.desc: A unique ID that identifies different activities.

response_param.name: ^title
response_param.desc: Activity name set by the seller. Returned on successful fixed-price, direct-discount, flash-sale, BMSM, GWP, and BXGY updates. Not returned on successful shipping-discount updates.

response_param.name: ^update_time
response_param.desc: Last update time as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

    configuration.AddAppInfo(appKey, appSecret)

    request := apiClient.PromotionV202309API.Promotion202309ActivitiesActivityIdPut(context.Background(), "7402881377634567979")
    request = request.XTtsAccessToken("your access token")
    request = request.ContentType("application/json")
    request = request.ShopCipher("your shop cipher")
    promotion202309UpdatePromotionActivityRequestBody := promotion_v202309.NewPromotion202309UpdatePromotionActivityRequestBody()
    promotion202309UpdatePromotionActivityRequestBody.SetTitle("BlackFridayDiscount")
    promotion202309UpdatePromotionActivityRequestBody.SetDurationType("NORMAL")
    promotion202309UpdatePromotionActivityRequestBody.SetBeginTime(1661756811)
    promotion202309UpdatePromotionActivityRequestBody.SetEndTime(1661856811)
    promotion202309UpdatePromotionActivityRequestBody.SetProductLevel("PRODUCT")
    promotion202309UpdatePromotionActivityRequestBodyParticipationLimit := promotion_v202309.NewPromotion202309UpdatePromotionActivityRequestBodyParticipationLimit()
    promotion202309UpdatePromotionActivityRequestBodyParticipationLimit.SetType("BUYER_NO_LIMIT")

    promotion202309UpdatePromotionActivityRequestBodyDiscountBxgyDiscount := promotion_v202309.NewPromotion202309UpdatePromotionActivityRequestBodyDiscountBxgyDiscount()
    promotion202309UpdatePromotionActivityRequestBodyDiscountBxgyDiscount.SetThresholdType("MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY")
